subject: Banking
title: What Makes a Neobank Different
description: A quick win: understand What Makes a Neobank Different.

hook.text: Neobanks have no branches, no tellers, and often no banking license.

buildup.text: Chime, Revolut, N26, and Nubank serve over 200 million customers globally.

discovery.text: Without branch costs, neobanks offer no-fee accounts, early direct deposit.

twist.text: Most neobanks partner with licensed banks that actually hold your deposits.

climax.text: Neobanks redesigned the user experience, not the banking system.

punchline.text: 200 million customers. Zero branches. Neobanks redesigned banking's surface.

quiz.question: Why don't most neobanks have banking licenses?
options: They partner with licensed banks that hold deposits

details.summary: Neobanks are digital-only financial institutions that operate without physical branches, offering lower fees and better user experience through technology. They challenge traditional banks but often lack full banking licenses and profitability.
details.whyItMatters: Neobanks represent a fundamental rethinking of how banking should work. Their focus on user experience and low costs has forced the entire banking industry to improve, benefiting all consumers.
takeaways: Neobanks typically have no physical branches and operate entirely through apps
Lower overhead allows them to offer free accounts and higher savings rates
Many neobanks partner with licensed banks rather than holding their own charters

faq.question: Is my money safe in a neobank?
faq.answer: If the neobank partners with an FDIC-insured bank or holds its own banking license, deposits are protected up to $250,000 just like at a traditional bank. Always verify the insurance status before depositing significant amounts.

faq.question: What can traditional banks do that neobanks cannot?
faq.answer: Traditional banks still have advantages in complex products like mortgages, business lending, wealth management, safe deposit boxes, notarized documents, and large cash transactions that require physical infrastructure.
